scopeReview: SPS-7.C.1–3: GDP/GNI per capita, formal/informal structure, distribution, literacy and health indicators, GII and HDI with scope and comparison limits.
varietyReview: Four meaningful original stimuli: national-income adjustment, household distributions, raw HDI components and a regional GII choropleth. Other applications test metadata, informal measurement and multidimensional development.
repetitionReview: Different denominators, units and index directions; no fabricated composite formula or ranking. Residency distinguished from citizenship, standard HDI from broader sustainability and national means from individual outcomes. Varied keys; all options explained, difficulty uncalibrated.
referenceNote: Official scope and primary UNDP/World Bank definitions checked. All values and diagrams hypothetical/original; no personal financial/medical advice, source question copying or independent human-review claim.
